newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo sees intl beverage loss for 1997.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo sees intl beverage loss for 1997.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc expects a net loss from its international beverage operations of $25 million to $50 million in 1997, a company spokeswoman said Tuesday.
Margaret Moore said the company anticipates a "net loss base" of $125 million to $150 million in international beverage operations this year after it implements restructuring changes.
Atop that base, the company will earn about $100 million, putting the loss for the year from the segment at $25 million to $50 million, she said.
PepsiCo's international beverage operations lost $404 million, after charges, in the fourth quarter of 1996.
